about: Homepage hero (web-clips.sh hero): hard cuts between recorded takes, in order unified inbox, link warning, undo send, archive and keep in the vault, search. Seconds are each take's own .mov time; crops are window points at 16:10, clear of the header's date line and the window's rounded bottom corners. The search cut is the search-local take's two segments: the typing ends at the press, the results are cropped below the lanes row, so no search time is in any frame.
